build_llama_model: build a Llama instance by loading a pre-trained model from checkpoint files and tokenizer
generate_text_from_prompts: generate text sequences from tokenized prompts using nucleus sampling with temperature and top-p controls
complete_text_prompts: complete a list of text prompts using the Llama model with configurable temperature and top-p sampling
chat_completion_dialogs: generate assistant responses for conversational dialogs with system, user, and assistant message roles
sample_top_p_tokens: sample tokens from a probability distribution using top-p nucleus sampling with a given threshold
